title: Alexander Valiensi Kent
intro:
Alexander Valiensi Kent (independent) is running for election to the U.S. House to represent Wisconsin's 3rd Congressional District. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026.
Kent completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.
